observability_triage.rationale: VRTC/VBACKUP handling and the R16-R20/R25 bias networks are deterministic schematic, net, footprint, and placement facts. However, the current KiCad build represents them as zero-pin generic placeholders: it has no AXP2101 pin 27, VRTC, test pad, named resistors, button connectors, or sensor-signal connectivity to validate.
interfaces_inspected: dist/design.kicad_pcb footprints, pads, nets, and positions
repair_requirements: Generate a real AXP2101 symbol/footprint with numbered VBACKUP and VRTC pins plus PWROK and a placed test pad/via.
Generate R16, R17, R18, R19, R20, and R25 as real resistor components with values and pad-to-net connectivity.
Generate the button/switch and PIR/touch connectors with stable references and pin mappings.
Expose reference-linked values, positions, pins, pads, and net membership to deterministic parsing.

evidence: The auxiliary-pin placeholder has no pins.
The button/switch placeholder has no pins and none of R16-R20/R25 exist as KiCad components.
Parsed nets expose names only and cannot prove resistor or connector endpoints.
missing_observables: VRTC NC and VBACKUP pin 27 to an unpopulated test pad/via beside PWROK
R16/R17/R18 from 3V3 to the three active-LOW GPIO inputs with connector pin 1 on GND
R19/R20/R25 20 kΩ pull-downs to GND on PIR/touch signal nets
